description: Retrieve GraphQL schema details or system manifest. READ-ONLY: Non-destructive metadata discovery. Usage: 1. If 'typeNames' is provided: Returns the full SDL (Schema Definition Language) for the requested types, including fields and relations. 2. If 'typeNames' is omitted: Returns a Federated Manifest—a high-level summary of connected nodes, their capabilities, and available domain entities (not the full schema). Use this to navigate the federated graph topology before executing queries.

endpoint.description: Optional target GraphQL HTTP/HTTPS URL to dynamically switch endpoint before execution.

headers.description: JSON stringified object of extra HTTP headers for the introspection request (e.g. '{"Authorization": "Bearer token"}').

typeDepth.description: Depth of nested fields to retrieve (default: 2)

typeNames.description: List of specific GraphQL type names to introspect. If provided, returns the detailed SDL definitions for these types. If omitted, returns a system-wide Federated Manifest overview.

name: introspect-schema
